functions.name: handle_new_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, email, role)
  values (new.id, new.email, 'user')
  on conflict (id) do update
    set email = excluded.email,
        updated_at = now();

  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$select exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = auth.uid() and p.role = 'admin')$function$

handle_new_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, email, role)
  values (new.id, new.email, 'user')
  on conflict (id) do update
    set email = excluded.email,
        updated_at = now();

  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles
    where id = auth.uid()
      and role = 'admin'
  );
$function$
